_title: Security & CCTV for businesses and societies (B2B)
_pitch:
SecureView: HD CCTV cameras installed for shops, offices, factories and housing societies.
4-camera kit with 30 days of recording from ₹24,999 installed. Watch live on your phone.
2-year warranty, 1-year free service, then an annual maintenance contract (AMC) from ₹2,999.
Free site survey and quotation within 48 hours. GST invoice provided.
target: Businesses and housing societies in Pune that need security cameras

roles.name: Owner
roles.cares: cost, theft and staff watching, and seeing the place from my phone

roles.name: Admin or facility manager
roles.cares: a reliable setup, quick service when something breaks, and no headaches

roles.name: Society secretary
roles.cares: residents' safety, getting the committee to agree, and a fair price for the society fund

roles.name: Society treasurer
roles.cares: spending the society fund carefully, proper quotations and invoices

roles.name: Accounts or finance person
roles.cares: total cost, payment terms, GST invoice and no surprise AMC charges

behaviours.name: Gets three quotes
behaviours.how: Always compares at least three vendors before buying.

behaviours.name: Buys from a known local dealer
behaviours.how: Trusts a dealer they or a friend already know.

behaviours.name: Buys after a scare
behaviours.how: Acts only after a theft or incident nearby.

behaviours.name: Tender or committee process
behaviours.how: Needs written quotations and approval from others.
